Data in this report are from the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, and 49 U.S. states participating in NVDRS during 2015–2020
NVDRS is a state-based surveillance system that collects information from death certificates

methods_quotes.q: All comparisons between AI/AN and non-AI/AN persons were examined using Pearson’s chi-square tests
